subject.title: feat: expose publisher account feed URLs

question: Should ClawHub expose a permanent account-scoped public feed API in addition to the publisher-scoped feed, or keep publisher identity as the single public feed surface?
rationale: The branch adds both surfaces, while its declared prerequisite describes a publisher-only model; this defines a versioned public API and cannot be safely selected by an automated repair.

options.title: Keep publisher-only feeds
options.body: Land or adapt the canonical publisher-feed contract first, then retain this PR only as a narrow publisher-profile Feed-link follow-up.

options.title: Approve both identity scopes
options.body: Document the distinct account and publisher semantics, upgrade guarantees, and ownership of both v1 endpoint families before resolving the contract defects.

options.title: Pause the feed surface
options.body: Defer the public API until maintainers settle the identity and snapshot protocol direction.

recommendation.title: Keep publisher-only feeds
recommendation.body: Land or adapt the canonical publisher-feed contract first, then retain this PR only as a narrow publisher-profile Feed-link follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their exact-head review establishes active technical ownership of the unresolved v1 feed-contract decisions.
